review_evidence: README describes a large Lean development of Markov semigroups, functional inequalities, convergence, Dobrushin theory, Bakry–Émery, concentration and related matrix analysis.
Declaration scans show theorem-rich Abstract, Dobrushin, DobrushinZegarlinski, Matrix and diffusion modules with reusable definitions/axioms/proofs.

Inspected Instances/WorkInProgress/EuclideanTests.lean: despite its WIP/Test path it contains substantial Gaussian/Mehler/Hermite validation theorems and is therefore retained; WIP naming is not used as an exclusion proxy.
summary: Retain the complete markov-semigroups primary tree, including WIP/test modules with substantive formal theorems.
